requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K yields. No ink reformulation required; reuse existing Magi/Nessie ink.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher page yields for customers and competitive differentiation in the CISS market segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Reuse of Magi/Nessie ink; compatibility with new bottle keying and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles must deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, with CMY bottles supporting >8,000 pages, and be compatible with existing ink formulations.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new NGB keyed bottles and associated tank design provide spill-free reliability during user refill operations.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce mess or waste during refilling, enhancing product reputation and reducing support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design, IDS air management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage should occur during standard user refill scenarios as verified by reliability testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, while maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance tamper-resistance, product integrity, and maintain ease of use for consumable replacement.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing NOA-F design, push-push mechanism.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must include a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and retain click-on push-push and TDF features, verified by design review and functional testing.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end customers to replace Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F units themselves without requiring service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and aligns with customer expectations for maintainability.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of PHA and NOA-F for user accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F using standard instructions with no special tools, as validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Increase the warranty page life target to 80,000 pages for the new product SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market demands for higher durability and lower total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Reliability of critical components (PHA, tank, paperpath).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and reliability test data support 80,000-page life for the product.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization with Increased Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Optimize printer size to accommodate increased tank size and protrusion, including changes to input and output trays.
requirements.Rationale: Support larger ink tanks for higher yield while maintaining ergonomic and aesthetic standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, tray design, overall printer chassis.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Final printer design fits within defined size envelope, with trays and tank integrated without functional or ergonomic issues.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch Color Graphic Display (CGD) as the main user interface for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience by providing a modern, intuitive interface for printer management and operation.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UI/UX Team
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware support, hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes a 4.3” CGD that passes usability and functional tests for all core operations.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station design to manage aerosol emissions due to changes in tank design and spit platform.
requirements.Rationale: Ensure compliance with environmental and workplace safety standards as tank size and ink flow increase.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station, tank, and spit platform design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels measured during operation must meet or exceed regulatory and HP internal standards.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path components to support increased page life target (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation over the extended warranty and usage life.
requirements.Dependencies: Material selection, mechanical design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components must show no significant wear or failure in accelerated life testing to 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Enables extended life and reduces total cost of ownership for high-usage customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance part design, service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance parts can be replaced by service centers after 80k pages, with procedures documented and validated.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and air management system to support increased tank size and new bottle designs.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable ink flow, minimize startup failures, and maintain print quality with larger tanks and new bottles.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware, firmware development, tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm and air management demonstrate reliable operation in all test scenarios, with no startup failures or air ingestion issues.

requirements.Title: New Page Quality (PQ) Goals & Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new page quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion metrics to align with increased page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure that print quality is maintained throughout the life of the ink supply and meets customer expectations for high yield consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink, IDS, firmware algorithms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print samples and depletion data meet new PQ goals and defined yield metrics in validation testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel and EPEAT3/LOT4 Environmental Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets Blue Angel (for PDL SKU), EPEAT3, and LOT4 environmental and sustainability requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with regulatory and market-driven environmental standards, supporting HP’s sustainability commitments.
requirements.Dependencies: Material selection, energy consumption, packaging design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for Blue Angel, EPEAT3, and LOT4 as appropriate for each SKU.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging to ensure protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent shipping damage and ensure product arrives safely to customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design, supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration testing per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS Business Model
requirements.Description: Product must support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including required telemetry, remote management, and integration with HP service platforms.
requirements.Rationale: To enable new business models and revenue streams, and to support enterprise and SMB customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Model Team, IT, End Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, cloud integration, service platform compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product integrates with HP PaaS systems and supports all required telemetry and management features.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Support
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and enterprise support features, including compatibility with WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: To address the needs of SMB and enterprise customers for fleet management and integration with existing IT systems.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, driver support, solution platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is compatible with WJA, HPSM, and JAM, and passes solution integration testing.

requirements.Title: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD Driver and Client Support
requirements.Description: Ensure full support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, and UPD clients and drivers, as well as EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure broad compatibility and ease of deployment for all customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver development, firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients are fully functional and validated on the product.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence for S’27 Launch
requirements.Description: Meet the defined schedule checkpoints for hardware, NOA-F, and bottle development to enable S’27 time-to-market.
requirements.Rationale: Critical to achieving business goals and capturing market share.
requirements.Dependencies: All critical path development activities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All major checkpoints (Re-SI, DO, IL, DP, MC, VR, FCS, etc.) are met on schedule as documented in project plan.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Allow for flexible support of host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K configurations as needed for market adaptation.
requirements.Rationale: To offer configurable options for different market segments and maximize product flexibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, consumables configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product can be configured for 12K-CMYK or 6K trade page operation, as verified by configuration testing.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Constraint
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) has a service life of at least 65,000 pages as a minimum constraint.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain reliability and minimize service interventions prior to warranty life target.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA design, material selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA demonstrates at least 65,000-page life in accelerated reliability testing.
